pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
i built @SnarksPad, a launchpad on Solana where every coin trades against ZEC and holders are paid in ZEC from the trading fees.

it was built using @MeteoraAG Dynamic Bonding Curve for the @colosseum Crypto World’s Fair.

being a privacy enthusiast, shielded delivery is the part I care the most about. 

you opt in with a @Zcash address and your share lands in your shielded wallet once a week, with a memo you can check on the site. 

on the Zcash side, who got paid and how much is completely hidden. 

what stays public? your Solana wallet and what it holds.

$SNARKS is the official coin of the launchpad, it graduated from the Meteora curve to a DAMM v2 pool on Oct 12 and has 1026 holders today. 

$SNARKSCAT was the first coin to graduate on the launchpad today.

why fees and not a token tax? holders are paid from the trading fee, never from the coin's supply. 

the pad's share of fees goes into a 2-of-3 Squads vault, so no single key can move it. 

meteora takes 20% of every fee at every tier.

earlier today, 2, 4, 6 and 10% fee tiers went live on the launchpad.

on those, the creator gets 40% of every fee and that split is written into the Meteora config, so it never changes. 

holders are paid from the rest

why $ZEC? there is no other quote pair as a show of our conviction in the zcash ecosystem.

we are the go-to launchpad if you want to launch a memecoin where your holders are paid in native ZEC.

snarks.fun
